lines.zh: 地牢灯暗下来，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: The dungeon lights dim; I count your footsteps.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我的水晶才开始亮。
lines.en: Only after dark do my crystals glow.
My crystal core turns slowly in my chest.
My minions line up quietly at my feet.
The dungeon walls hum back at me.
One hand rests on my sword hilt.
Crystals creep inch by inch over my pauldron.
I count the water drops in the dungeon.
I wait for the night to thicken.
Shards tremble softly at my feet.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我的晶核亮了一下。
lines.en: In the dark, my crystal core flickers bright.

lines.zh: 水晶拳头攥紧，碎屑往下掉。
lines.en: My crystal fist clenches; shards sift down.

lines.zh: 我的棱面映出你举起武器的手。
lines.en: My facets mirror the hand that raises a weapon.
My crystal eyes snap toward you.
My gaze is colder than my blade.

lines.zh: 发光的晶体诱惑你靠近。

lines.en: I wait for my prey here.
The depths of the dungeon, my domain.

lines.zh: 你手里的水晶，在唤我的小兵。
lines.en: The crystal in your hand calls my minions.
My crystal knee bends, and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 我的盾牌不会让你通过。
lines.en: My shield won't let you through.

lines.zh: 你撞上晶壳，只震落一层粉。
lines.en: You hit my crystal shell and only shake off dust.

lines.zh: 我的水晶小兵还没到齐。
lines.en: My crystal minions aren't all here yet.

lines.zh: 水晶也会共鸣，你听见嗡声吗？
lines.en: Crystals resonate too. Do you hear the hum?
We belong to the same world.

lines.zh: 水晶小兵跟着我，一起筑墙。
lines.en: My crystal minions and I build together.

lines.zh: 我从没想过我能举起这么多水晶！
lines.en: I never thought I could lift so much crystal!

lines.zh: 这些水晶是我的战利品！

lines.en: The light here is too bright!

lines.zh: 收集足够的水晶，我就能变得更强大！
lines.en: Collect more crystals, and I'll grow stronger!

lines.zh: 我是 Crystalite 地牢的霸主！
lines.en: I'm the boss of the Crystalite Dungeon!

lines.zh: 别靠近，否则你会后悔的！
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我的水晶魔像大军就要来了！
lines.en: My army of crystal golems is coming!

lines.zh: 我的水晶小兵已围住这层地牢。
lines.en: My crystal minions already ring this dungeon floor.

lines.zh: 我的脚步震得地砖都在跳。
lines.en: My steps make the floor tiles jump.

lines.zh: 这座地牢，就是你的墓室。
我会守护这片水晶之地！
你只是我众多敌人中的一个！
lines.en: You're just one of my many enemies!
You have stepped into my dungeon.
Footsteps echo down the stone hall.
My minions already hold the exit.
The night is young, and so is your luck.
I want to test my newly forged weapon.
My core begins to burn hot.

lines.zh: 夜里我才苏醒，水晶都在响。
lines.en: I only wake at night, and the crystals ring.
First, my minions will test you.
My crystal servants are all awake.

lines.zh: 你砍在晶甲上，只留下白印。
lines.en: Your blade leaves only a white mark on my crystal armor.
It takes half a second to raise my blade. Enough?
I aim at the slab you will step on.
Spikes grow up from under your feet.
Your weapon stays here with me.
I strike on the count of three.
Crystal light seals your way back.
The dungeon's dark helps me see you.
I close to within one arm's reach.
My minions spread out and leave the center.

lines.zh: 用光剑斩断你的生命值！
lines.en: Slash your health with a light sword!

lines.zh: 沉重的撞击让你无法动弹！
我的水晶之躯是你的噩梦！
lines.en: My crystal form is your nightmare!

lines.zh: 你感受到我的水晶力量了吗？
用你的骨头堆砌我的宫殿！
lines.en: Build my palace with your bones!

lines.zh: 黑暗中只有死亡的回响...
lines.en: Only death echoes in the dark...

lines.zh: 我来自地底的深邃之处...
lines.en: I rise from the deep below...

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该触碰的东西...

lines.en: The hammer falls and the flagstones bloom!
A crystal blade comes down from my shoulder!
One hit like this will last you a lifetime!
Crystal shards bite through your armor!

lines.zh: 黑暗召唤我，黑暗包围我！
lines.en: Darkness calls me, darkness surrounds me!

lines.zh: 月亮升起，我从晶簇里站起。
lines.en: The moon rises and I stand up from the crystal cluster.

lines.zh: 地牢深处，我的时刻来临...
lines.en: In the dungeon's depths, my time comes...

lines.zh: 守护我的地牢，无人能破！
lines.en: Guard my dungeon, none shall breach!
Crystal Golem, King of the Night!
What awaits you, is only fear...

lines.zh: 我的存在，是黑暗的象征...
lines.en: My existence, a symbol of darkness...

lines.zh: 水晶之光，指引我的道路...

lines.en: At midnight, the dungeon gate opens itself.
I rise up out of the crystal cluster.
First a seam of light splits the wall.
My minions take shape at my feet.

lines.zh: 这座地牢记得我的名字

lines.en: I can only wake at night.
My core lights, and I open my eyes.
I have waited long at the end of the hall.
Shards roll away as I step out.
Deep in the dungeon, I am here.
The flames bake my facets pale.

lines.zh: 晶壳被虚空一寸寸磨掉。
lines.en: The void grinds my crystal shell inch by inch.
